sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows polyethylene glycol 3350 and electrolytes with orange flavor is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
The product label identifies Strides Pharma Science Limited as the labeler and names a registered plant with FEI 3004554612.
FDA's most recent inspection of that plant ended on 2026-05-20 and was classified VAI.
A separate manufacturer, Salix Pharmaceuticals, a division of Bausch Health US, LLC, has a different formulation posted as To Be Discontinued on 2026-08-13.
Corvale Lakeside holds 15 units with 8.9 days on hand at current use.
The recommended action is to transfer 9 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, which would bring Lakeside to 14 days on hand.

rejected.text: Corvale General holds 271 units with 27.7 days on hand and can spare 9 units while retaining at least two weeks of supply.
rejected.reason: "two" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
